author: Zephyr I
title: Mechanistic Probes v2 (fixed, test-only): Head-only z→logits grad norms, spectral norms, attention selectivity
abstract: Fixes Flax unbound module error by wrapping attention pooling in a Module. Zero-cost test(): computes head-only z→logits gradient norms and Dense spectral norms for three heads (Dual Attn⊕GAP deep, Simple+Attn, GAP-only) on a shared PG backbone feature batch; also reports attention entropy/top‑5 and LN‑ConvLSTM gate stats. No training; prints JSON.
